evidence: Established in 1969, this artistic sanctuary has been carrying on the traditional theatrical art form, proudly bearing the name Thang Long, which echoes the legendary tale of King Ly Thai To's relocation of the capital, testifying to the enduring vitality of Vietnam's wet rice civilization. The rustic bamboo screen, suspended mysteriously, conceals the artisans as they skillfully manipulate the wooden puppets, their vermilion red and glossy lacquer glistening in the soft light.
